description: PHP class for handling JPEG images in a canvas context, extending a GD-based image canvas class, with methods for outputting and saving JPEG images with configurable quality.

classes.name: Image_Canvas_GD_JPG
classes.description: A PHP class for creating and manipulating JPEG images in a canvas, extending the Image_Canvas_GD class, with configurable quality settings.

methods.name: Image_Canvas_GD_JPG
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the JPEG canvas with optional quality parameter.

methods.name: show
methods.description: Outputs the JPEG image directly to the browser with appropriate headers.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves the JPEG image to a specified filename.
